## Decision

Wave-2 slices (S2-CLI, S2-MOTIVE, S2-SLICE) each own a disjoint src/gw subtree and all import the S1-SCHEMA Zod types; S1-SCHEMA is a mandatory tracer bullet and no wave-2 slice may define a frontmatter type.

## Rationale

Fencing a shared data model by acceptance criterion makes each implementer define its own frontmatter type and validate only its own branch. That shape is behind three prior defects in this repo. File-ownership fencing removes the race on an undefined type.

## Alternatives Considered

- Fence wave-2 slices by AC-1/AC-2/AC-4 and let each define the frontmatter it needs
- Single sequential slice for the whole store layer, no parallelism
